outgoing.explanation: The 1602-03 archdeaconry will of the East Dereham widow is the probate half of the pre-Francis household evidence.

sources.excerpt: Gurnye, Margery, of East Dereham, widow - will, 1602-03
sources.locator: collection 62679, record 257086; ANF will register Liber 35 (Offwood), fo. 191; FamilySearch film 008045772 (affiliate-restricted)

statement: Margery Gurney (indexed "Gurnye"), widow, of East Dereham proved a will in 1602-03 in the Archdeaconry of Norfolk, the humble-estates court - register Liber 35 (Offwood), fo. 191. Her widowhood places a Gurney husband dead in the parish before 1602, years before Francis Gurney's documented residence began. Index-level: the register film is affiliate-restricted, so the will text (which could name her husband and children) is unread.
